transcribed_question:
A) Identify the structure Pinned "Green" Renal Papillae
B) Identify the structure Pinned "Blue" Renal Pelvis
C) The Right and the Left Kidney Lie on the Same Vertebral Level? T/F False

marker.description: Green-headed pin indicating the renal papillae

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the green pin.
main_explanation: The green pin points to the apices of the renal pyramids, which project into the minor calyces. These are known as the renal papillae.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures drains directly into the renal pelvis?
supporting_question.explanation: The major calyces (formed by the union of minor calyces) converge to form the renal pelvis, which then continues as the ureter.

true_false.statement: The right and left kidneys lie on the same vertebral level.
true_false.explanation: The right kidney is typically positioned slightly lower than the left kidney due to the presence of the liver in the right upper quadrant.
